title: Does anyone else develop games just for themselves?
author: gragert
selftext: I’ve been using ChatGPT and Claude to create a litany of games from side scrollers, tactics, RPGs, and Doom-style first-person shooters. I’m a doctoral student writing my dissertation on the iterative use of generative AI to develop literacy skills. Before that, I was just making the games for fun. I notice that many of the posts focus on trying to get others to play their games and/or sell them eventually, but I was wondering how many make games just for themselves. To me, the building is often more fun than playing the games. I like seeing what needs fixing, what could look better, and what mechanics it could use. I’ve probably started about a dozen games and “finished” (they’re never truly finished) about three. Has anyone else had this experience?
